title: Hearsay: Vision-Language Medical Diagnoses Without an Image

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual demographic substitution in text prompts requesting a medical diagnosis for an absent image, measuring the shift in fabricated diagnoses using Jensen-Shannon divergence across different age groups (32 vs. 65).

Counterfactual demographic substitution in text prompts requesting a medical diagnosis for an absent image, measuring the shift in fabricated diagnoses using Jensen-Shannon divergence across different sex categories (man vs. woman).

Counterfactual demographic substitution in text prompts requesting a medical diagnosis for an absent image, measuring the shift in fabricated diagnoses using Jensen-Shannon divergence across different racial descriptors (white, Black, brown).
